admin.courses.description: Top-level container for the certification. Topics, questions, and questionnaires each belong to a course.
admin.courses.intro.title: Quick start: how to set up a course
admin.courses.intro.description: Six steps from an empty course to your first participant assignment.
admin.courses.intro.step1.title: Create the course
admin.courses.intro.step1.body: Give the course a title and a short description on the right. The course is the top-level container for everything that belongs to it.
admin.courses.intro.step2.title: Add topics
admin.courses.intro.step2.body: Open the course and add topics. Topics group questions and drive the learning recommendations candidates see when they don't pass.
admin.courses.intro.step3.title: Create questions
admin.courses.intro.step3.body: Switch to the Question Bank and create questions. Each belongs to this course and (optionally) a topic. Choose single- or multiple-choice and mark the correct answers.
admin.courses.intro.step4.title: Build a questionnaire
admin.courses.intro.step4.body: Under Questionnaires, create a new questionnaire for the course. Pick questions from the pool, set the passing threshold (default 80%), and choose whether to shuffle questions and answers.
admin.courses.intro.step5.title: Activate the questionnaire
admin.courses.intro.step5.body: Activate the questionnaire once every question has been reviewed and at least one correct answer is marked on each.
admin.courses.intro.step6.title: Assign to a participant
admin.courses.intro.step6.body: Under Participants, create a person and a certification assignment. The system generates a personal access link you can share.
